manual QA for career counts and historical claims; never required for production

advanced_sources.policy: Best-effort context only; no advanced source may block or silently alter LevLine.

career_qb_verification.guardrail: Career facts come from full weekly player stats with a 10-attempt meaningful-game threshold and are cross-checked against the recent PBP game IDs; conflicts fail closed and are not published.

coaching.source: Wikipedia season-page rendered infoboxes + explicit staff tables

editorial_finalizer.guardrail: Final editorial pass changes only public explanation and story hierarchy, never LevLine probabilities.

editorial_intelligence.guardrail: Diversity ranking changes only explanatory evidence, never LevLine probabilities.

editorial_text_safety.guardrail: Punctuation-only publication repair; source facts, standardized status language, and LevLine model values are unchanged.

evidence.guardrail: Context is explanatory only unless a feature is separately validated and promoted into the numerical model.

ftn.note: current season charting not yet available

media_reporting.source_policy: Matchup relevance is mandatory; betting content is excluded; established reporting outranks low-trust aggregators; source diversity is preferred. X is optional and lower-trust by default. Media never moves LevLine numerically.

nextgen_qb_context.guardrail: NGS adds player-level explanatory context only; it does not alter LevLine without separate chronological validation.
nextgen_qb_context.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse

personnel_usage.guardrail: Prior usage clarifies role importance but is not converted into an unvalidated point-value injury adjustment; ambiguous abbreviated-name matches are discarded.
personnel_usage.source: NFL.com official injury report + nflverse PBP usage

previews.generator: Sunday Signal ranked story-spine + slate-aware voice composer
previews.guardrail: The Read synthesizes verified context; detailed modules below retain the underlying facts and sources. Neither layer alters LevLine probabilities.

qb_history.guardrail: Historical quarterback evidence follows the player across team changes but remains explanatory and is discounted for system/personnel changes.

qb_history_verification.guardrail: Displayed counts are explicitly recent nflverse PBP samples; short cameos do not count as meaningful games and no limited sample is presented as a career total.

staff_impact.guardrail: Coordinator impact is a historical tendency projection for explanation only; it does not alter LevLine unless separately validated out of sample.
staff_impact.source: Wikipedia rendered staff records + FTN charting + nflverse PBP

story_desk.guardrail: Rivalry, event, history and fun-fact context is explanatory only and never changes LevLine numerically.
